newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brokers SGE Delahaye, Exane boost Renault.
newsitem.headline: Brokers SGE Delahaye, Exane boost Renault.

text.p: Brokerage houses SGE Delahaye and Exane upgraded their recommendations on the stock of Renault SA RENA.PA on Friday, market sources said.
Exane switched to reinforce from sell, and SGE Delahaye to neutral from underperform, citing a lower than expected pre-exceptional loss for 1996 and a breakeven forecast for the car division.
Renault shares were up 2.54 percent at 141.50 francs at 1345 GMT, while the bourse's CAC-40 index was up 1.85 percent.

Cheuvreux de Virieu had raised its rating to buy on February 28, the day after Renault announced a plant closure. NatWest Sellier retains a hold recommendation while Transbourse retains a sell recommendation.
